pkgmetadata.longdescription: Numcodecs is a Python package providing buffer compression and transformation codecs for use in data storage and communication. It includes Blosc (with lz4, zstd, zlib), gzip, bz2, lzma, zstd, lz4, fletcher32, crc32c, msgpack, and other codecs, primarily for use with the Zarr array storage library.

use.flag: Enable crc32c checksum codec via dev-python/crc32c
